# SuitePacific

> Boutique NetSuite post-go-live support and consulting. SuiteScript development, workflow automation, integration maintenance, advanced PDF templates, saved searches and dashboards, and ongoing account management for companies already live on NetSuite.

## Services

- [NetSuite Post-Go-Live Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-post-go-live-support): What ongoing support covers after the implementation ends
- [NetSuite Managed Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-managed-support): Fixed monthly retainer covering development, administration, break-fix, and upgrade preparation
- [NetSuite Care Plans](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-care): Monthly retainer plans from $799 to $2,499/month for ongoing SuiteScript, workflow, reporting, and troubleshooting support; 3-month minimum then month-to-month
- [Hire a NetSuite Developer](https://suitepacific.com/hire-netsuite-developer): Dedicated SuiteScript developer for custom scripts, integrations, and automation; no long-term lock-in
- [NetSuite SuiteScript Development](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-suitescript-development): Custom SuiteScript 2.1 user event, scheduled, map/reduce, client, and RESTlet scripts
- [NetSuite Workflow Automation](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-workflow-automation): Multi-step approval routing, notification automation, and SuiteFlow process management
- [NetSuite Advanced PDF Templates](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-advanced-pdf-templates): FreeMarker-based invoice, purchase order, statement, and custom document templates
- [NetSuite Saved Searches and Dashboards](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-saved-searches-dashboards): Real-time operational visibility through saved searches, KPI tiles, and dashboards
- [NetSuite Health Check](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-health-check): Structured account review to identify performance, customization, and integration issues
- [NetSuite Account Optimization](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-account-optimization): Systematic improvement of an existing NetSuite account: scripts, workflows, integrations, and configuration
- [NetSuite Technical Debt](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-technical-debt): Assessment and remediation of accumulated technical debt from rapid implementation or staff turnover
- [NetSuite Partner Replacement](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-partner-replacement): Transition from an implementation partner to a retained specialist
- [NetSuite Emergency Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-emergency-support): Urgent break-fix for scripts, workflows, and integrations failing in production
- [NetSuite Administrator Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-administrator-support): Day-to-day NetSuite administration: roles, permissions, records, reports, and configuration
- [NetSuite Consulting Services](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-consulting-services): Scoped consulting engagements for specific NetSuite challenges after go-live
- [NetSuite Implementation Rescue](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-implementation-rescue): Stabilizing a NetSuite account after a failed or incomplete implementation
- [NetSuite Integrations](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-integrations): Shopify, Salesforce, Celigo, Boomi, and custom middleware integration maintenance
- [NetSuite SuiteBilling Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-suitebilling-support): Ongoing SuiteBilling configuration, charge generation, ARM, and billing automation support
- [NetSuite FSM Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-fsm-support): NetSuite Field Service Management configuration, customization, and upgrade support
- [NetSuite Support UK](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-support-uk): Post-go-live NetSuite support for UK-based businesses
- [NetSuite ACS Alternative](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-acs-alternative): Third-party support that covers customizations and integrations excluded by ACS
- [NetSuite Support Alternative](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-support-alternative): What a third-party consulting firm covers that Oracle support does not

## About

SuitePacific is a boutique consulting firm focused exclusively on post-go-live NetSuite accounts. Credentials: SuiteCloud Developer II, Administrator Professional. Engagements are month-to-month; no annual lock-in. Direct access to the consultant managing the account on every request. Serving clients in the US, UK, and Australia.
